latestHairCandidateStatus: r129 將 Blender 官方 CC0 Hair shader EEVEE 的雙色、根部加深、隨機色與噪聲機制離線複製為 AevryndOwnedLayeredHairMaterial_v249r129，採 deep-brown 自有色盤；引擎 runtime 依賴為 none，毛髮幾何與 r101/r94 balanced groom 不變。完整 11 視角及 frame 20 姿勢無新增材質破面；frame 1/20 對人體與三層服裝零穿模，五個動態狀態每狀態 224,460 個髮點與 3,946 個 rigid scalp 頂點皆零違規。50 幀 CPU profile 為 solver 9.065ms、follow 4.026ms、合計 13.091ms。髮絲與深棕色層次明顯優於 r101 的黑色塊，但前額 scalp carrier 仍像塗色補片、分線過寬、髮際偏高且根部過度平行；只升為毛髮材質技術候選，不取代 r38 或網站 v83。
latestHairMaterialStudy: r129 deep-brown Aevrynd-owned derivative of Blender official CC0 Hair shader EEVEE; material, collision, dynamic and performance gates passed; strict hairline/face display gate failed
latestEyeCandidateStatus: r175 preserves r109's collision-safe tear arcs and adds the owned aevrynd-iris-hazel-v61 texture plus physical corneal response (alpha 0.14, IOR 1.376, roughness 0.024, coat 0.28/0.028). Fixed catchlight meshes remain disabled; highlights come from the scene lights and corneal geometry. The complete 11-shot review has no material breakage. A frame 1/20 geometry parity audit compares 61 Mesh/Curves objects and 1,454,277 points plus face indices per frame; both SHA-256 digests exactly match r163, so no collision geometry changed. Eye material is about 50/100 and eyelid anatomy remains insufficient, so this is a technical material candidate only and the public website remains v83.
latestFaceCandidateStatus: r183 is the first eyelid study applied to the final evaluated v249 shape-key surface rather than being hidden in Basis. It consolidates the active philtrum and eye-aperture keys, applies a restrained 0.72 eyelid field, recesses the eye assembly by 1.0mm, offsets upper lashes by 0.55mm, and restores 18 vertices around five self-intersection guard polygons. Frame 1/20 audits show no regression for cornea, iris, pupil, sclera, tear layers, canthi, lashes, or face self-intersections. The complete 11-shot review is stable, but strict facial quality is still about 45/100 because the orbital planes, eyelid silhouette, skin response, and hairline remain visibly synthetic. It is retained only as a collision-safe eye-topology research node and does not replace the visual integration baseline or website v83.
latestSkinCandidateStatus: r173 recomputes owned complexion and roughness fields on the actual 41,692-vertex v249 body, adding cheek/nose/under-eye/temple color zones, T-zone and dry-zone roughness, and dual-scale pores. r175 combines that skin with the owned iris and physical cornea response. Full 11-shot review passes and the frame 1/20 geometry SHA-256 is exactly identical to r163 across 61 objects/1,454,277 points, proving materials changed without collision geometry changes. Strict skin material quality is about 55/100; face geometry remains about 42/100, so it is not a final visual promotion.
latestRejectedExperiment: r177-r182 anatomical eyelid sweeps and clearance recovery
latestRejectedReason: r177-r178 repeated the r176 mistake by editing Basis while two active shape keys continued to determine the evaluated face, so the visible result remained negligible. r179 proved the corrected from-mix consolidation method and exposed a readable 0.72/1.00/1.28 sweep. r180's 1.28 field regressed multiple eye layers and face self-intersections; r181's 1.00 field still regressed iris and face contacts; r182's 0.72 field cleared all eye-layer regressions but added three/two face self-intersections at frames 1/20. These are rejected experiments; r183 keeps the method and guards the five diagnosed polygons.

latestHairScalpCandidateStatus: r163 derives a clean scalp shell from the same shaped body surface, copies all 21 skin-weight groups and Armature deformation, excludes the concave temple crease, and keeps 1.2mm authored clearance. Its 2,626 vertices/2,438 faces and r162 177,353-point pruned curly layer pass frame 1/20 collision checks against body and all three clothing solids. It reduces crown exposure but still fails strict overall hair appearance, so it is a scalp deformation/collision technical candidate only.
